historical_commentary.text: Custom hand-drawn gauges like this thermometer example have been largely superseded by native gauge form objects in later 4D versions and by rich JS/CSS-based visualizations in modern web areas, making this note primarily of historical/educational interest as an example of classic-era 4D form drawing technique.
related_updates: Later 4D versions and web-based components provide native gauge/progress-indicator widgets, reducing the need for hand-drawn thermometer-style gauges
